name: RTI-353
summary: RTI(-4229)-353 is a phenyltropane derived drug which acts as an SSRI. Tamagnan et al. also made some phenyltropanes with high activity and selectivity for the SERT (pM affinity).

pharmacology.text: RTI(-4229)-353 is a phenyltropane derived drug which acts as an SSRI. Tamagnan et al. also made some phenyltropanes with high activity and selectivity for the SERT (pM affinity).

uses.en: It is used only in laboratory research and is not a medicine.
uses.zh: 它僅用於實驗室研究，並不是藥物。
uses.zhHans: 它仅用于实验室研究，并不是药物。

fact.en: Although it is built on cocaine's tropane skeleton, RTI-353 acts on the serotonin transporter, like an SSRI antidepressant rather than a stimulant.
fact.zh: 雖然以古柯鹼的托烷骨架為基礎，RTI-353 作用於血清素轉運蛋白，表現像 SSRI 抗憂鬱藥而不是興奮劑。
fact.zhHans: 虽然以古柯碱的托烷骨架为基础，RTI-353 作用于血清素转运蛋白，表现像 SSRI 抗忧郁药而不是兴奋剂。
